svg.title: Green Lantern power battery - fluid path and internal layout, side view
svg.text: Fluid path and internal layout — side view (section)
1.8× rebuild, ~430 mm tall; schematic, not to scale
tube and wires pass its neck
USB power bank, standing on edge
(or flat on the floor if it fits)
ring key cap in the rotor pocket
removable drip tray under the glass
vented cap: air in as liquid leaves;
top protrudes into the lower dish
bottle, swap the bank, USB access
